a.lede: In a post on Truth Social, President Trump says only one man can take Jensen Huang's place as head of Nvidia: Tim Cook.
a.title: Trump floats Apple chairman Tim Cook as Jensen Huang’s successor

b.lede: President Trump says Tim Cook should replace Jensen Huang as CEO of Nvidia.
b.title: President Trump says Apple’s Tim Cook is the only man to replace Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO
